label: Preact + preact-iso + @preact/signals
router: preact-iso: LocationProvider + Router/Route, plain <a href> (intercepted by LocationProvider), useRoute, useLocation().route
state: @preact/signals: a createAppState() factory of signal + computed shared through context (the docs' global-state shape); useSignal/useComputed for the form
notes: Routes are imported synchronously (preact-iso's docs also show lazy(); the contract keeps every arm in one entry chunk unless the framework splits by itself).
npm installs preact-iso's peer preact-render-to-string; it is not imported by the client bundle.
